runners_data.name: Mahon Falls

races.paceDynamic: Bathara will take the field along uncontested as the sole confirmed front runner, setting a sustainable gallop that suits her style perfectly. With Mahon Falls and Gnomon likely to track in behind, the pace will be honest but not destructive, setting up a tactical finish where positioning and stamina over this staying trip become crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Bathara Stays Strong
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady and no serious challenge materializes until late
scenarios.body: Bathara maintains her advantage turning for home and has enough left to repel late challenges. The combination of uncontested lead and good going suits her perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is too slow early and the race becomes a sprint from the last
scenarios.body: West Hill Verde and other hold-up horses get the perfect setup to unleash finishing kicks. The patient tactics pay off in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Gnomon or Mahon Falls travel sweetly in behind and time their move perfectly
scenarios.body: One of the prominent runners capitalizes on their ideal position to challenge Bathara at the optimum moment. Their superior race fitness tells in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset Special
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites fail to handle the trip or jumping under pressure
scenarios.body: The Egyptian Ginge finds significant improvement or another runner exceeds expectations in a messy finish. Class and form get turned on its head over this demanding distance.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Bathara gets an easy time in front as she becomes very hard to peg back with an uncontested lead
Monitor how West Hill Verde travels through the race as he needs specific pace scenarios to be effective from the rear
Check Gnomon's jumping early as confident hurdling will be key to his prominent position paying off
Observe if Mahon Falls can finally convert consistent placed form into a victory at this longer trip
Note The Egyptian Ginge's early position as any forward move would signal improved form

runners_data.name: Sherborne
runners_data.note: Strong record on similar going with recent form figures showing consistency in competitive handicaps

runners_data.name: Noahsgreatrainbow
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner whose tactical advantage could prove decisive over this stamina-testing trip

runners_data.name: Diplomatic Ash
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits but recent form suggests he may struggle to match the pace of these better-rated rivals

runners_data.name: Moroder
runners_data.note: Highest official rating in the field and proven at this distance with solid form on good ground

runners_data.name: Limetree Boy
runners_data.note: Lowest-rated runner who needs a strongly run race to show his best form against these higher-class opponents

races.paceDynamic: Noahsgreatrainbow will dictate terms from the front with no other confirmed leaders, allowing him to control the gallop throughout this 2m5f test. The four prominent runners (Sherborne, Diplomatic Ash, Moroder, Limetree Boy) will settle behind in a compact group, creating a tactical affair where the pace could quicken dramatically from 3f out as they try to reel in the lone leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Noahsgreatrainbow Controls All
scenarios.trigger: If the leader can judge his fractions perfectly and kick clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Noahsgreatrainbow's tactical advantage proves decisive as he times his effort to perfection over this stamina-sapping trip. The chasers leave their runs too late to bridge the gap he creates in the straight.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge From Pack
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners time their challenges to perfection and swamp the leader late
scenarios.body: Sherborne and Moroder emerge from the chasing pack to collar a tiring Noahsgreatrainbow in the final 100 yards. The sustained gallop from 3f out plays perfectly into the hands of these strong-staying types.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle Explodes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with multiple moves from the chasing group
scenarios.body: Diplomatic Ash and Sherborne force the tempo from 4f out, turning this into a true test of stamina. Limetree Boy finds improvement under these genuinely run conditions to outbattle his higher-rated rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Folds Early
scenarios.trigger: If Noahsgreatrainbow goes too fast early or makes jumping errors under pressure
scenarios.body: Moroder inherits the lead approaching the final fence as the pace-setter capitulates. The highest-rated runner in the field has too much class for his rivals when getting first run on them.

watchPoints.text: Noahsgreatrainbow must be monitored for any early jumping errors that could compromise his front-running tactics
Moroder's recent question marks over longer distances need resolving if he's to justify his rating advantage
Sherborne's prominent style could see him well-placed if the pace becomes truly testing from halfway
Diplomatic Ash needs to bounce back from disappointing recent efforts to play a meaningful role
Limetree Boy requires a genuinely run race to bridge the significant class gap with his four rivals

races.paceDynamic: King Al will likely lead or share the early pace, but with 10+ prominent runners including Senator, Talakan, Gallivanted, and Cayman Dancer, there will be significant early pressure. This creates a scenario where the pace could collapse in the final stages, favoring the hold-up horses Munsif, The Bellhop, and potentially Bandjo if they can stay in touch.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If King Al leads but gets pressed hard by multiple prominent runners early
scenarios.body: The large group of prominent runners creates unsustainable fractions through the first mile. Hold-up horses Munsif and The Bellhop storm home past tiring leaders.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners mark each other and the pace becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: King Al and Talakan engage in a tactical battle with multiple prominent runners hesitant to commit. The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If King Al gets an uncontested lead and the prominent runners fail to pressure
scenarios.body: King Al establishes control early while the large group of prominent runners gets in each other's way behind. He maintains just enough advantage to hold off late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely strong and sustained throughout without collapsing
scenarios.body: The honest pace suits the most genuine stayers and those with proven stamina over the trip. Galactique's staying power and Cayman Dancer's form over similar distances proves decisive.

watchPoints.text: King Al could get an easy lead if prominent runners are too respectful early, making him very dangerous
Munsif needs the pace to be genuinely strong throughout to showcase his hold-up style effectively

races.paceDynamic: Yes Indeed will likely take them along at a sustainable gallop with no other natural front-runners in this small field. scenarios.trigger: If Yes Indeed gets an uncontested lead and maintains rhythm

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses time it right
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady enough for closers to mount challenges
scenarios.body: Pure Carbon and Haas Boy use their superior ratings to good effect with well-timed late runs. The bunched finish favors horses with the class to quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical mess helps outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the small field creates a stop-start tactical affair
scenarios.body: The lack of natural pace-makers leads to a messy race where positioning becomes lottery-like. Authoceltic or Cobbler's Boy benefit from the chaos as the fancied horses get caught in traffic or make their moves too early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Class tells in driving finish
scenarios.trigger: If Yes Indeed sets strong gallop and higher-rated horses respond late
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more demanding than expected, suiting Pure Carbon's consistent form profile. His superior official rating and good going record see him home in a battle of stamina.

Pure Carbon's jumping under pressure as he's had some mixed efforts when things get competitive

races.paceDynamic: Copperhead looks the clear pace angle with his prominent style and recent front-running tendencies, likely to dictate terms from the front with minimal early pressure. Hold Your Fort may track closely given his prominent preference, but the two hold-up horses Certainly Red and Gabbys Cross will likely settle at the back, creating a strung-out field where the pace-setter could steal a march if allowed an easy lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Copperhead Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Copperhead gets an uncontested lead and manages fractions intelligently
scenarios.body: His higher rating and recent form suggest he can dictate and kick clear when challenged. Hold Your Fort may track but lacks the class edge, while the hold-up pair face a tough task from off the pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold Your Fort Pressures Early
scenarios.trigger: If Hold Your Fort forces the pace from the outset rather than settling behind Copperhead
scenarios.body: The sustained pressure could crack Copperhead's resistance and set up Hold Your Fort's staying power to prevail. His excellent record on similar going (3W from 12) supports this tactical switch paying dividends.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Certainly Red's Class Tells
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses or becomes truly run to suit hold-up horses with a strong gallop
scenarios.body: Certainly Red's superior rating of 137 and proven ability to win from off the pace could see him sweep past tired leaders. Gabbys Cross could also benefit but lacks Certainly Red's proven quality at this level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Gabbys Cross Surprise Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a complete staying test with minimal pace early allowing all to stay in contention
scenarios.body: His hold-up style could catch others napping if they've gone too hard early, though his modest rating makes this the least likely outcome. Would need everything to fall perfectly into place for his running style.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Hold Your Fort decides to challenge Copperhead early rather than settling - could create genuine pace pressure
Monitor how freely Copperhead travels in front - any signs of laboring early could open the door for closers Certainly Red and Gabbys Cross
Keep an eye on Certainly Red's position turning for home - needs to be within striking distance to utilize his class advantage
Watch for any jumping errors from the leaders Copperhead or Hold Your Fort which could hand initiative to the hold-up pair
Observe if Gabbys Cross gets the strong gallop he needs - without it his chances diminish significantly given his rating disadvantage
